title: Spheric Bombs
description:
Explore an Explosive World of Strategy and Reflection!Immerse yourself in a turn-based 3D tactical puzzle game that tests your strategic skills. Guide a bomb through stimulating grid-based levels, where every move counts. Face unique challenges, unlock achievements, plan your strategy and survive to claim victory. Are you prepared to tackle the most challenging puzzles?

Key Features:• 25 Unique Levels: Go through a variety of levels, each presenting unique challenges and objectives.

• Unlock 25 Achievements: Showcase your skills by unlocking 25 achievements, earned by completing each level with 100 life points.

• Explosive Tactical Puzzles: Engage in a captivating blend of puzzle-solving and tactical decision-making, putting your thinking skills to the test.

• Strategic Buffs and Debuffs: Consider the strategically placed buffs and debuffs throughout the various levels, adding a tactical dimension to every decision.

Face 8 Types of Enemies:Discover imposing opponents, each possessing distinct characteristics. Anticipate their moves to survive, but beware, when they fuse, they become even more powerful! 

• Pyrospheric: Walks on magma cubes without taking damage.

• Hydrospheric: Walks on water cubes.

• Atmospheric: Jumps up to 4 cubes instead of 2.

• Terraspheric: Reduces the player's damage resistance.

• Chronospheric: Add 2 turns to the game.

• Tempospheric: Skips the next player's turn.

• Sinistospheric: Inflicts fatal damage to the player.

• Electrospheric: Moves by 2 cubes instead of 1.

Fusion Rule:If enemies are at the same level, the moving one consumes the stationary one. Otherwise, the higher-level always consumes the lower-level. 

Buffs and Debuffs:The player can pick up buffs and debuffs by passing through or by finishing on them. These effects apply only to the player.

Achievement Hunter Tips:• Sometimes, it's better to skip your turn on the current cube.

• Be aware of the enemies playing order to take advantage of it.

• Git Gud.

Developer's Note:I'm thrilled to share this game with you. Your support means the world to me as a solo developer. Have fun and good luck!
description_short: Explore an explosive world of strategy and reflection in this 3D turn-based tactical puzzle game! Guide a bomb through 25 unique levels, combining puzzle and tactics. Immerse yourself in a difficult and stimulating experience, balanced between relaxation and reflection.
